name: Channel3 Shopping
description:
Shop 100M+ products from thousands of retailers without leaving Claude. Search by text or image, compare every retailer's live price and offer side by side, check 30-day price history, and find similar products in an interactive storefront.

Once connected, mention "Channel3" in your prompt to trigger the app.

server.name: Channel3
server.title: Channel3 Shopping
server.description: Shopping search across 100M+ products, with every retailer's offer and live price in one place.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Use Channel3 to search products and compare live retailer offers.
Call search_products separately for each distinct product type.
Call get_products for full details by product ID or retailer URL.
Results appear in a storefront UI — comment or recommend; do not re-list what the user can see.
For deictic references ("this product"), use the storefront model context.
Every Channel3 result includes a thread_id — always pass it back unchanged as thread_id on every subsequent Channel3 call in the same conversation, even for unrelated searches.

tool.name: search_products
tool.title: Search Products
tool.description:
Search 100M+ products across thousands of retailers for one product type. Call once for each distinct product type, and send independent calls together. Put relevant constraints in `query`.
Returns up to 8 product cards plus structured product data. The result includes a `thread_id`. You MUST include it unchanged as the `thread_id` parameter on every subsequent Channel3 tool call in this conversation — including searches for new, unrelated products. Never omit it once you have one.

query.description:
One product type and its constraints in natural language (brand, color, material, size, price, gender).
Good: "red leather jacket under $200"; "leather golf glove under $40".
Bad: "gift ideas for dad"; "cool sneakers"; "golf glove or rangefinder".

image_url.description: Public image URL for visual search. Combine with `query` for text + image.

thread_id.description: Conversation thread ID. Omit ONLY on the very first Channel3 call of a conversation. From then on, always pass the `thread_id` from the most recent Channel3 result, unchanged — even when the new call is a completely different product search.

as_of.description: ISO timestamp of when this result was produced; prices are live as of this moment.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Channel3 Shopping to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Channel3 Shopping to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trychannel3.com/.

_published_faq.name: Is Channel3 Shopping MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Channel3 Shopping scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Channel3 Shopping's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Channel3 Shopping scores 77/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 6 of 6 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Channel3 Shopping MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Channel3 Shopping provides these MCP tools: get_products and search_products.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Channel3 Shopping?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Channel3 Shopping in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Channel3 Shopping MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Channel3 Shopping does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can Channel3 Shopping improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: get_similar is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 69/100. 1 of 4 inputs have descriptions. Add descriptions to the missing inputs, including where to obtain IDs and how to supply values. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
Channel3 Shopping is developed by Channel3. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
